events.label: FedEx (FDX) fiscal Q4 earnings — after close
events.note: FedEx fiscal Q4 results: logistics and freight demand read-through for broader economic health. In a HOLD regime with macro uncertainty, a FDX miss (volume decline, cost pressures) would reinforce the stagflation narrative supporting DXY bid. A beat (volume growth, pricing power) signals the consumer/business demand cycle is intact — paradoxically hawkish for rate hike odds.

events.label: NVDA Annual Meeting (9 AM PT virtual) + Micron Q3 FY2026 earnings (after close) + S&P Global flash PMIs (9:45 AM ET)
events.note: Triple-catalyst day for the AI-semis complex. (1) NVDA Annual Meeting (9 AM PT): Jensen Huang to address AI demand trajectory, Taiwan $150B spending commitment, and post-$25B-debt-offering capex plan. Q2 guidance $91B is the anchor; HBM demand and Blackwell Ultra cadence are the key signals. Add NVDA before 9 AM PT regardless of DXY gate status (override catalyst). (2) Micron Q3 FY2026 (after close): consensus $34.66B revenue / $19.95 EPS / >80% gross margin; HBM sold-out through 2026-2027; pre-earnings price action MU +8.70% on analyst upgrades (TD Cowen $1,500, RBC $1,200, Aletheia $1,600); TSM +6.9% on June 22 is the sector confirmation. Beat-and-raise ($35B+ guidance) → BUY upgrade pathway opens. Miss (<$31B guidance) → step aside immediately. (3) S&P Global flash PMIs: Services >53 = hawkish July FOMC hike pressure; <50 = dovish. GOOGL AI talent exodus (June 22) makes this the defining week for AI software vs AI hardware thesis.

events.label: May 2026 PCE inflation + Q1 GDP third (final) estimate + Weekly jobless claims (BEA/DOL, 8:30 AM ET)
events.note: TRIPLE DATA RISK at 8:30 AM ET — previously listed as two events; GDP third estimate rescheduled to this day per BEA release calendar (was incorrectly noted as June 23). (1) PCE: consensus +0.5% MoM, 4.1% YoY; core +0.3% MoM, 3.4% YoY — a print ≥4.0% YoY validates all 9 hike dots and could push 30Y above 5.00% regime trigger. (2) Q1 2026 GDP third (final) estimate: Q2 second estimate showed 1.6%, down from 2.0% advance; upward revision >2.0% reinforces hike-without-recession thesis. (3) Weekly jobless claims: low claims = strong labor = hawkish spike. All three in the same 8:30 release creates the week's maximum data risk. Size all exits and hedges before this print.

events.label: Russell Reconstitution effective at close — ~$11T passive rebalancing
events.note: Russell 2000 annual reconstitution effective after June 26 close (trading begins June 29). ~$11 trillion in passive assets rebalancing simultaneously. 2026 is the first year of semi-annual reconstitution (June + December). Build positions in newly added names before June 24; take profits before Friday close if PCE on June 25 was hawkish. Russell 2000 +2.12% on June 22 shows passive front-running already underway. A hawkish PCE on June 25 + $11T passive rebalancing on June 26 = most disorderly potential tape of Q3.

events.label: SK Hynix Nasdaq ADR — SEC clearance expected by end of week
events.note: SK Hynix Nasdaq ADR listing: SEC clearance expected by June 26. CAUTION: SK Hynix fell ~12% on June 23 (Kospi circuit-breakers triggered twice) on Broadcom AI chip guidance miss cascade ($16B vs $17.2B expected Q3 FY2026); prior unconditional BUY stance suspended pending MU June 24 HBM earnings read-through. If MU beats and raises FY2027 HBM guidance, ADR clearance remains a re-entry catalyst (~$14B raise, Nasdaq debut targeting August 2026). If MU disappoints, ADR clearance event may trigger forced selling in Korean HBM names.

events.label: June CPI release (est.) — most important inflation data of the summer
events.note: May CPI 4.2% triggered 9 FOMC hike dots and regime breach on June 17. June CPI (released ~July 14) is the next recalibration: if CPI holds ≥4.0%, hike probability for July 28-29 FOMC spikes materially; if CPI falls to ≤3.7% (aided by Iran-deal oil disinflation), the rate path softens and BUY regime can re-open with high conviction. GOOGL AI talent situation and SPCX capital structure risk will also have had 3 weeks to stabilize by this date.

events.label: Next FOMC meeting (July 28-29) — rate hike now on the table; 9 of 18 hike dots from June
events.note: Nine of 18 FOMC officials projected at least one 2026 rate hike at the June 17 meeting. A 25-bps hike (3.50-3.75% → 3.75-4.00%) at this meeting is now priced at non-trivial probability. July CPI data (~July 14) is the primary input. Rate hike = BEARISH regime confirmation. Hold = regime-dependent on interim data.

events.label: Iran-US Islamabad Declaration 60-day deadline — Hormuz full reopening + sanctions relief
events.note: Deal operational from June 18 MOU signing; 60-day window expires August 13. Qatar/Pakistan 60-day roadmap brokered at Burgenstock (June 22 announcement). Hormuz central route still has ~80 mines as of June 19 — mine-clearance measured in weeks. Failure to meet the August 13 deadline = oil spike reversal and energy re-rally; key summer positioning watch. XLE short thesis hinges on this deadline being met.

events.label: SPCX first earnings as a public company (approx.) — Starlink ARR + Starship cadence
events.note: First earnings print since the June 12 IPO. SPCX blown out June 22 (-16.4%) on $20B inaugural bond offering; $185 two-consecutive-close re-entry framework has been reset from $165.78 base. Capital structure context: $75B IPO + $60B xAI acquisition + $20B bond offering = $155B in obligations. First earnings (Starlink subscriber/ARR growth, Starship launch cadence, cash burn rate) is the fundamental clearing event for re-entry. Two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume required before re-entry regardless of earnings date.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut, early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs; size accordingly into the window. The $20B bond offering (June 22) already changed the capital structure risk profile — the lock-up expiry adds the equity supply overhang on top. Exact date pending the prospectus's stated terms.
